caption: The drawing depicts a carved figure of a monkey standing upright on two legs. The monkey’s arms are folded across its chest, with its right arm supporting a circular opening or indentation in its left forearm. The tail curves around the front of the body and wraps to the left side. The figure is rendered in shades of gray, blue, and reddish-brown, with visible wood grain texture suggesting it is carved from painted wood. The facial features are distinctly defined, with prominent eyebrows, round eyes, a flat nose, and a closed mouth. The background is plain and off-white. Below the figure, the text “CIRCUS WAGON MONKEY” is written in capital letters.
title: Circus Wagon Monkey
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
